failure.message: The managed package builder can clone, verify, and invoke the Gorm build, but the extracted staged toolchain build still resolves GNUstep Make/Foundation through host paths and fails before reaching the previous NSMassFormatter blocker.

next_actions.message: Run the Gorm package build after setup has relocated the managed toolchain so GNUstep Make, Foundation, GUI, Back, and Objective-C headers resolve from the managed root rather than host distro paths.
Add a package-build preflight that records gnustep-config --objc-flags and rejects host /usr/include/GNUstep leakage for managed artifacts.
